posts.title: Celebrating Joseph Ssentongo's Birthday with a Donation to Nakaseke Pediatric Ward
posts.body: In the spirit of giving, we're celebrating our CEO Joseph Ssentongo's birthday by donating Seph Nutri Porridge to the children at Nakaseke Pediatric Ward on 9th September. Joining us: Seph Nutri Warriors, Scouts, Rotaracts, and the Nutrition Club — dressed in Seph Partnership t-shirts. A dinner at Access Guest House follows to close out the day. Small acts of kindness create a healthier and brighter tomorrow.
